verdicts.explanation: The paper states LiAl5O8's independent Li-ion conductivity is only ~10^-6 S/cm, and the sentence carries the citation marker 38 (Ito et al.), so literature_cited is correct. No measurement temperature is given, so null is right.

The paper says 'previously LiCl alone has been shown to have insufficient ionic conductivity (~10^-6 S/cm)' with citation markers 48,49, so the value is literature_cited for LiCl. No temperature is stated.
The paper reports Li2B6O9F2's experimental ionic conductivity as ~10^-10 S/cm and cites ref. 47 (Pilz and Jansen) for it, so literature_cited is correct. No temperature is given.

The paper says an improvement up to ~10^-5 S/cm was found in solid solutions of Li4SiO4 and Li5GaSi2O8, citing ref. 45, so literature_cited is correct. The family-level material name matches the paper's wording and no temperature is stated.
